messages:
talia: Quick RFC follow-up: propose we add a tiny, stable pair for spend attribution: `cost_fp` (<=16 chars) + `cost_lvl` (0-4). keep metric cardinality low.

mike: can you give a concrete header/envelope example?

talia: headers: `X-RWI-Cost-Fp: signup_v2` and `X-RWI-Cost-Lvl: 2`. kafka envelope: `{meta:{cost_fp: "signup_v2", cost_lvl:2}}`. consumers copy on outgoing calls.

pranay: enforcement question: how do we stop teams creating thousands of fingerprints?

talia: registry with CI lint + privacy review. unknown values become `fp_unknown` mapped to conservative cost_lvl. also auto-alert on cardinality drift.

oliver: sampling: if cost_lvl>=3 we should bump trace sampling and retain full payload N days. that catches expensive outliers.

neha: privacy note: registry entries require a short rationale and must not include PII or dataset ids. add a renewal TTL (90d) to avoid rot.

jess-bot: created tasks: OBS-costfp-schema, OBS-sdk-lint, OBS-kafka-envelope, OBS-costmap-sync. links: https://go/r/OBS-costfp (internal).

mike: metrics: do NOT attach fingerprints to high-cardinality metric series. emit hourly aggregates aggregated_by(cost_fp) only, and map cost_lvl->approx_cost in optimize service.

pranay: alerting: trigger when >3 new fps/week by same team or org-wide fp count crosses threshold.

talia: rollout plan: schema PR -> SDK lint -> kafka contract bump -> two-week shadow metrics -> enable aggregates -> docs + onboarding. I'll open the registry template today. reconvene next Tue for quick sync. :thumbsup:
